claims.statement: The package requires Python >=3.10 and five exact direct Python distributions.
The optional release-clinic extra declares twelve direct minimum-version requirements.
The build backend is setuptools.build_meta with setuptools >=68.
Root npm declares eight direct runtime libraries and source UI test development dependencies.
Full setup adds Release Clinic, Windows pywin32, and root npm installation. Core-only setup omits those extras.
Offline preparation downloads binary wheels, verifies local Python resolution, and caches locked npm tarballs.
The wheel build copies Release Clinic assets and scaffold paths; Node connector source remains separately installed.
Root engine metadata accepts Node >=22, while setup accepts Node 22.12+ within 22 or Node >=24.
claims.reason: The root metadata accepts versions rejected by setup, including Node 22.0-22.11 and Node 23.

claims.statement: The native bridge declares nine connector families. Exact tool grants control calls.
PostgreSQL settings use pg, verified TLS by default, a ten-second connection timeout, and default read-only sessions.
PostgreSQL reads use BEGIN READ ONLY, bounded timeouts, privileged-role rejection, parameterized queries, and row limits.
Kibana configuration requires one authentication method and explicit indices; searches require described field mappings.
Kibana sends fixed mapping or search operations through /api/console/proxy with index checks, no redirects, and response bounds.
Vault source loads configuration, disables proxy inheritance and TLS certificate verification, and authenticates through AppRole unless development mode applies.
The optional hosted service calls Vault.connect during its startup lifespan.
The Release Clinic Confluence client supplies configured credentials, disables TLS verification, and defaults to direct routing.
The web crawler starts a system browser with --no-sandbox and --ignore-certificate-errors.
The web search helper disables hostname and certificate verification.
The core stores action records in local .workbench/actions.sqlite3 and rejects symbolic links for state paths.
Connector configuration reads root .env then applies process-environment overrides.
The dependency guide distinguishes package downloads from live runtime endpoint access and documents Python lock limits.
The CLI declares workspace initialization, status, doctor, validation, authoring lint, Gherkin checks, resource discovery, and dispatch.
The runtime describes registered resources and enforces declared provider operation compatibility.
Ten built-in providers cover knowledge, repositories, tests, logs, SQLite, Eureka, graph snapshots, connectors, and release reports.
The source declares sixteen canonical shared skills and runtime skill-file discovery.
The CLI declares evidence coverage, ledgers, baseline comparison, graph extraction/comparison, test planning/preflight, and stdio MCP.
Governance validation is deterministic; semantic correctness and reviewer authentication are outside that command.
Durable workflow scheduling and independent agent orchestration remain later-phase work.
The gRPC recognizer includes specialized Java SDK identifiers; extraction does not establish universal language support.
Live endpoint access, deployed grants, and target-platform execution remain unknown in this source-only profile.
